metadata.keyword_label: listing-linked keyword candidates (not proven sales drivers)

method_notes.Dataset: Etsy Radar - Category B, PHASE 1 (40 shops + 50 keywords). Draft for Mohsin review; not published or pushed.
method_notes.Sources: Etsy_Master_Research_Updated.xlsx (84 accepted students, 188 distinct shops; 90-day review window 2026-08-09 to 2026-11-07 PKT) + Etsy Open API v3 GET /shops/{id} lookups on 2026-11-10 PKT. Derived from the Category B initial build.
method_notes.Internal hold rule: Shops under 6.0 months old (as of 2026-11-10) with 600+ est. sales/month are held back for a separate tier. They are removed from the shop list, from keyword support counts (# students, # shops, tagged listings, reviews) and from keyword examples. Checked across all 188 shops in the data.
method_notes.Shop rule: From the initial qualifying list (age > 3 months, est. revenue > $400/month, >=90%% digital listings, <30%% of 90d reviews on Halloween-titled listings), minus held shops; top 40 by est. monthly revenue.
method_notes.Revenue method: Est. monthly sales = Etsy API transaction_sold_count / age in months (create_date to 2026-11-10, days/30.44). Est. monthly revenue = sales/month x avg price (mean USD price of active digital listings weighted by 90d review records; fallback median). Non-USD prices converted with open.er-api.com USD rates, updated Tue, 10 Nov 2026 00:02:31 +0000.
method_notes.Assumptions: Lifetime average (even sales over shop life; seasonal/older shops may differ today). Gross transactions (line items) before discounts, fees, refunds. Reviewed listings assumed representative of what sells. Cross-check column = 90d reviews/3 x 10 x price (~1 review per 10 digital sales), comparison only.
method_notes.Keyword rule: Initial Category B ranking kept (by # shops, then # students, then 90d reviews on tagged listings). Support recomputed without held shops; each keyword needs >=3 shops, >=3 students and >=1 linked shop in the final 40. First 50 taken. Christmas/Thanksgiving allowed; Halloween, PLR/MRR/resale and generic format-only tags excluded.
method_notes.Keyword examples: Example = listing with the most 90d reviews among non-held shops, preferring shops in the final 40.
method_notes.Keyword label: All keywords are listing-linked keyword candidates (exact Etsy tags on listings with recent reviews). NOT proven sales drivers; no search volume or keyword-attributed sales measured.
method_notes.Competition check: Etsy search supply count + top-48 sample mean price from 2026-11-07 Demand Checks where available; blank = unchecked. Supply, not demand.
method_notes.Example PLR rule (2026-11-11): Keyword examples must not be PLR/MRR/resell-rights products: title, tags and description checked for plr, mrr, private label, master resell, commercial resale, resell/resale rights, and any un-negated "resell" (a "do not resell" licence restriction does not count). Example must carry the tag, come from a Phase 1 shop and have the most 90d reviews among eligible listings; otherwise left blank with a note.
method_notes.Back to school example: Example must have a school-themed title (school, classroom, teacher, first day, student, kindergarten, pencil, crayon).
